previous_assumption: Manually line-wrapping bullet text in the requirements.md fed to `matha init --from` at ~72 characters is harmless prose formatting.
correction: matha's markdown parser only captures up to the first line break of each bullet — line-wrapped bullets were silently truncated mid-sentence in .matha/hippocampus/rules.json (e.g. cut off at 'Transport/' instead of the full sentence). Had to wipe .matha/ and re-run init from a version of requirements.md with each bullet on one unwrapped line.
